products.title: Products
products.description: Maintain product master data, specifications, packaging, tags, gallery and publish state. The internal price is used for quotations and PIs only and never appears on the storefront.

help.sku: The SKU is the stable catalogue key and cannot change after creation.
help.slug: Used in the storefront URL. Slugs must be unique; generating a value replaces the field only when you click the button.
help.slugPublishedLocked: This product is published or has been published, so its URL slug is locked. Set it to Draft and save before changing the slug.
help.preOrder: Shows this product in the storefront home page pre-order rail. The lifecycle must be “Pre-order”; the catalogue badge and filters stay driven by the lifecycle.
help.preOrderDisabled: Set the lifecycle to “Pre-order” to use the home page pre-order flag.
help.category: Open the picker to search the real category tree. Any enabled category can be selected, including one that has subcategories. The product cannot be saved without a category.
help.englishRequired: English content is required: the storefront is English by default.
help.description: Plain text only. The storefront shows a short summary generated from it.
help.lifecycleDiscontinued: A discontinued product keeps its publish state but is not offered on the storefront.
help.unsaved: Unsaved changes are lost when you leave this page.

leads.description: Look the phone number up first, then register the conversation. One customer can hold many conversations.

analytics.description: Traffic figures are aggregates and countries are approximated from IP, so they may be wrong.

documents.amountsServerSide: Line amounts and totals are recomputed on the server.
